description_en: Resets and upgrades the log analysis feature. You can invoke this operation only in the pay-as-you-go pattern for logs
description_zh: 重置并升级日志分析服务。仅日志后付费模式支持调用
kebab_example: aliyun sas reset-log-shipper --ttl 180 --hot-ttl 7 --log-meta-list Status=enabled HotTtl=7 Ttl=60 ConfigLogStore=sas-security-log --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetLogShipper

parameters.help_en:
The global log retention period in days.

This parameter is supported only in the pay-as-you-go billing mode for logs
parameters.help_zh:
全局日志保存天数。

仅日志后付费模式支持
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The global data retention period in the hot storage tier.

Valid values: greater than or equal to 7 days and less than the log retention period
parameters.help_zh:
全局热存储层数据保存时间。

取值范围：大于等于7天，小于日志存储时间
parameters.name: hot_ttl

fields.help_en:
The Logstore to be configured.
You can call the [DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
fields.help_zh:
指定要配置的LogStore。
您可以调用[DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~)接口获取该参数
fields.name: config_log_store

fields.help_en:
The data retention period in the hot storage tier of the Logstore.

Valid values: greater than or equal to 7 days and less than the log retention period. Specifying the data retention period in the hot storage tier for a single Logstore overrides the global settings
fields.help_zh:
LogStore热存储层数据保存时间。

取值范围：大于等于7天，小于日志存储时间。指定单LogStore热存储层数据保存时间会覆盖全局设置
fields.name: hot_ttl

fields.help_en:
The current enabling status. Valid values:
disabled: The feature is disabled.
enabled: The feature is enabled
fields.help_zh:
当前启用状态。取值：
disabled：未启用。
enabled：启用
fields.name: status

fields.help_en:
The log retention period of the Logstore in days.

Specifying the log retention period for a single Logstore overrides the global settings
fields.help_zh:
LogStore日志保存天数。

指定单LogStore日志保存天数会覆盖全局设置
fields.name: ttl

parameters.help_en: The configuration information for log analysis in Security Center
parameters.help_zh: 云安全中心日志分析的配置信息
parameters.name: log_meta_list

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
